Candy Jones.
Ideas made concrete.

I’m an AI and operations consultant with more than 25 years of experience in assistance and organization. Trained in Airtable and Make, I start from real situations to create tools that make work and daily life easier.

Candy’s Universe brings together my apps, automations and concepts. Some are already available to test; others are taking shape. This portfolio shows my approach and the kinds of solutions we can imagine for your business.
